  This repository is the public release site for TRITON. It is generated from
  released upstream tags and cannot merge pull requests. Development happens at
  https://code.ornl.gov/hydro/triton -- please open your change there.
-->

## Please open this change upstream

Thank you for the contribution. **`triton-hydro/triton` cannot merge pull requests.**
It publishes releases of TRITON: every commit here is generated from an upstream
release tag, and the chain is assembled elsewhere and pushed. A merge made on
this side would block the next release rather than travel with it, and it would
never reach the people working on the code.

TRITON is developed at <https://code.ornl.gov/hydro/triton>.
To get this change reviewed:

1. Create an account on that GitLab instance if you do not have one.
2. Fork the project, push this branch to your fork, and open a merge request at
   <https://code.ornl.gov/hydro/triton/-/merge_requests>.
3. Link the merge request below, then close this pull request.

If you cannot create an upstream account, open an issue at
<https://code.ornl.gov/hydro/triton/-/issues>
describing the change, and attach a patch produced with `git format-patch`.

**Upstream merge request or issue:** <!-- paste the link here -->

---

Reporting a problem rather than proposing a change?

- Bugs, questions, and feature requests: <https://code.ornl.gov/hydro/triton/-/issues>
- A bad checksum, a missing asset, or a tarball that will not extract: also
  <https://code.ornl.gov/hydro/triton/-/issues>,
  quoting the version tag and the asset name
- Security-sensitive reports: open a **confidential** issue upstream, not a
  public one

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the full policy.
